name: LastingSales – For Contact Form 7 & WP Forms
author: lastingsales

sections.description:
LastingSales connects to Contact Form 7 and WP Forms to give you instant alerts of new leads, so you can get in touch with them via WhatsApp, SMS, iMessage, or phone call within seconds.

It also offers auto-personalised messages and content, trackable PDF files and pages, automatic follow up reminders, and many more features to help you manage your leads and increase sales conversion.

All of this can be done easily from your phone via our mobile app, which works with WhatsApp, SMS, email, and other popular chat apps.

In addition to WordPress Contact Form 7 and WP Forms, LastingSales can also integrate with other lead sources such as Facebook Lead Ads, Google Ad Lead Forms Extensions, Zapier, and other website contact forms.
sections.installation: Setup token and email in wordpress admin to start receiving leads from Contact Form 7 and WP Forms in LastingSales CRM.
